# VoDs

List, upload, import, and delete video-on-demand assets and recordings.

Part of the [API Catalog](./). Full schemas: [Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/).

## Conventions

| Placeholder | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| `{domain}` | Server hostname or IP |
| `{app}` | Application name (often `live`) |
| Path/query placeholders | Match the parameter name in the tables below |

Use port `5080` with `http://` for local HTTP tests.

**Base URL:** `https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/...`

**Auth:** [IP filter](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/securing-rest-apis/) or `-H "Authorization: Bearer {JWTToken}"` — see [Secure with JWT](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/jwt-rest-api-filter/).

:::tip Windows Command Prompt
Escape JSON quotes in `-d` bodies: `-d "{""name"":""My Stream""}"`
:::

## `deleteVoDsBulk`

[Delete bulk VoD Files based on Vod Id](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/deleteVoDsBulk) — Deletes multiple VoD files from the database by their IDs.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/vods` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | query | yes | Comma-separated IDs of the VoD files |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods?ids={ids}"
```

## `deleteVoD`

[Delete specific VoD File](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/deleteVoD) — Deletes a specific VoD file from the database by its ID.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/vods/{id}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | ID of the VoD file |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/{id}"
```

## `getVoD`

[VoD file from database](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/getVoD) — Retrieves a VoD file from the database by its ID.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `GET` | `/rest/v2/vods/{id}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | ID of the VoD file |

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/{id}"
```

## `getTotalVodNumber`

[Get the total number of VoDs](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/getTotalVodNumber) — Retrieves the total number of VoD files in the database.

## `getTotalVodNumber_1`

[Get the partial number of VoDs depending on the searched items](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/getTotalVodNumber_1) — Retrieves the number of VoD files that include the specified search parameter.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `GET` | `/rest/v2/vods/count/{search}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `search` | path | yes | Search parameter to get the number of items including it |

```bash

  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/count/{search}"
```

## `uploadVoDFile`

[Upload external VoD file to Ant Media Server](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/uploadVoDFile) — Uploads an external VoD file to Ant Media Server.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/vods/create` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `name` | query | yes | Name of the VoD File |

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -F "file=@{path/to/file}" \
  -F "metadata={metadata}" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/create?name={name}"
```

## `unlinksVoD`

[Unlinks VoD path from streams directory and delete the database record.](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/unlinksVoD) — Deletes the database record associated with the specified directory, without deleting the files themselves.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/vods/directory` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `directory` | query | yes | The full path of the directory from which imported VoD files will be deleted from the database |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/directory?directory={directory}"
```

## `importVoDs`

[Import VoD files from a directory and make them streamable.](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/importVoDs) — Imports VoD files from a directory to the datastore and links them to the streams.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/vods/directory` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `directory` | query | yes | The full path of the directory that VoD files will be imported to the datastore and linked to the streams |

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/directory?directory={directory}"
```

## `getVodList`

[Get the VoD list from database](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/getVodList) — Retrieves the list of VoD files from the database. It returns up to 50 items. You can use offset value to get result page by page.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `GET` | `/rest/v2/vods/list/{offset}/{size}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `offset` | path | yes | Offset of the list |
| `size` | path | yes | Number of items that will be fetched |
| `sort_by` | query | no | Field to sort. Possible values are 'name', 'date' |
| `order_by` | query | no | 'asc' for Ascending, 'desc' for Descending order |
| `streamId` | query | no | ID of the stream to filter the results by stream ID |
| `search` | query | no | Search string |

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/vods/list/{offset}/{size}?sort_by={sort_by}&order_by={order_by}&streamId={streamId}&search={search}"
```
